rule: Elements are added cumulatively on the right side: dot, then T-end, then second dot, so next adds another T-style bar end on the top-right line while keeping both dots. Option 5 does this; option 1 is just the last figure unchanged. All of options 3-5 turn the T into an L, so the match is imperfect.

A circle and a square sit at the same height on opposite sides, the height steps down each figure and circle/square swap sides alternately, so the next has circle left and square right at the same low height. Only options 5 (and 2, with sides swapped) have equal heights; thick bars pattern is unclear.
